item.title: MK Peretz responds to attacks: 'No one has a monopoly on love of the land'
item.description:
MK Eliyasaf Peretz of the Yashar party responded to an offensive social media post about him that stated, "The successful brothers are gone, and we're left with the trash." Peretz replied that he had served nearly 500 days of reserve duty over the past three years and that his family had paid a heavy price. "We lost those dearest to us, but we did not lose faith in our path," he wrote.
Peretz emphasized that he remains a right-winger and that his decision to pursue a different political path does not change his values. "No one has a monopoly on love of the land, Zionism, or loyalty to the State of Israel," he wrote, calling for an end to hatred over political disagreements.
"We can disagree, criticize, and even be angry, but the hatred and venom must stop."

item.title: Tragedy: Israeli dies on ski trip in France
item.description: Israeli citizen dies following a cardiac event while on a ski trip in France. ZAKA working with the Foreign Ministry and French authorities to arrange for his body to be repatriated.

item.title: Unrest in Jerusalem: Police working to disperse haredi rioters
item.description:
Jerusalem District Police officers, Border Police personnel, and Special Patrol Unit forces are working to disperse a riot involving extremist haredi protesters on Bar-Ilan Street in Jerusalem, during which roads were blocked and infrastructure was damaged.
Police said that after an officer declared the gathering unlawful and ordered the demonstrators to leave, they refused to comply.
As a result, security forces began dispersing the protesters, using force and crowd-control measures.

item.title: Rabbi Yaakov Medan visits son's Unity Tent: 'Prayer alone is not enough'
item.description: Visiting his son MK Elisha Medan's Unity Tent, Rabbi Yaakov Medan urges Israelis to turn prayers for national unity into meaningful action and dialogue.

item.title: Tragedy in France: Israeli dies during ski trip
item.description:
An Israeli citizen died following a cardiac event while on a ski vacation at the Val Thorens resort in France.
Members of the ZAKA international unit, in coordination with the Foreign Ministry, are working with local authorities in France to obtain the necessary permits and complete the procedures required to repatriate his body to Israel.
